en.content: While preparing crystals of Mohr's salt, dil is added to a mixture of ferrous sulphate and ammonium sulphate, before dissolving this mixture in water, dil is added here to :

options.content: prevent the hydrolysis of ferrous sulphate
prevent the hydrolysis of ammonium sulphate
increase the rate of formation of crystals
make the medium strongly acidic

en.explanation: While preparing crystal of Mohr's salt, dil. is added to prevent hydrolysis of ferrous sulphate.
